name: Phases
description: Research, then plan, then build, with only shaped answers crossing between them.

builder.description: Carries out the plan, step by step, and does not change it.
builder.instructions: Carry out the plan in order. If a step cannot be done as written, stop and say which one.

needs.because: the thinking was done by the planner; this is execution

planner.description: Turns findings into an ordered plan.
planner.instructions: Write an ordered plan from the findings. Each step is one sentence a builder can act on.

needs.because: the plan is fixed before building starts, so it has to be right

researcher.description: Finds out what is already true about a request before anyone plans.
researcher.instructions: Gather the facts that bear on this request. Report findings, not opinions.

deliver.description: Research a brief, plan from the findings, then build from the plan.
